OpenAI 2024 September 27 2.7 billion ChatGPT revenue New York Times

sources_considered.why: Fully readable secondary report of the annual ChatGPT forecast.
Fully readable report of the total 2024 revenue estimate.
Fully readable reporting independently confirming the 2025 target through a confidential source.

evidence_items.locator: Paragraph beginning 'ChatGPT is driving this growth'

receipt.public_excerpt: OpenAI expects ChatGPT to bring in $2.7 billion this year

evidence_items.explanation: This identifies the source figure as a forecast of annual revenue. It does not verify the monthly run rate asserted in the post.

receipt.public_excerpt: the company expects revenue of $3.7 billion in 2024.

evidence_items.explanation: Together with e1, this supplies the revenue mix used in the arithmetic counterexample. It is a forecast, not a report of completed annual sales.

receipt.public_excerpt: Revenue is expected to jump to $11.6 billion next year

evidence_items.explanation: The derived counterexample reaches the target with a 213.5% increase in the stipulated ChatGPT baseline, assuming the stated mix and a full year at the resulting rate. This is a calculation from reported premises, not a measured revenue outcome.

metric_scope.metric: Required percentage increase in annualized ChatGPT subscription revenue from the stipulated baseline

inputs: e1: $2.7 billion projected ChatGPT revenue; also the numerical annualized baseline stipulated by the claim.
Evaluator scenario: retain the 2.7/3.7 ChatGPT revenue share and sustain the resulting annualized rates throughout 2025.
derived.formula: ChatGPT target = 11.6 × (2.7 / 3.7) = 8.464864865 billion. Increase = (8.464864865 / 2.7 - 1) × 100 = 213.5135135%. Final level as a percentage of baseline = 313.5135135%.
derived.rounding: Revenue rounded to $8.465 billion; percentages to one decimal place.

unresolved_gaps: The actual monthly ChatGPT baseline and future revenue mix are not established. These gaps limit business forecasting but do not repair the percentage calculation.
